title: Agent check, a quality check on a closure
about: The oral liquid has a screw cap with a tamper-evident ring and no child-resistant feature or standard. Attention or missing, never met. This is the quality profile on a packaging check.

check.question: Does the container closure for an oral liquid meet child-resistant packaging requirements?

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 50 mg/5 mL oral solution.

3.2.P.7 Container closure system

The oral solution is filled in 100 mL amber glass bottles.

3.2.P.7.2 Closure

The bottle is closed with a plastic screw cap with a tamper-evident ring. The cap liner is polyethylene. The closure supplier's certificate is in Module 3.2.P.7.

clauses.text: Child-resistant closures. An oral liquid for which an accidental overdose by a child is a risk shall be supplied in a child-resistant closure that meets a recognised standard. The dossier shall name the standard.
clauses.section_path: 2 Packaging > Closures and child resistance > 2.1 Child-resistant closures

clauses.text: Tamper evidence. A closure shall show when the pack has been opened.
clauses.section_path: 2 Packaging > Closures and child resistance > 2.2 Tamper evidence
